data.text/markdown:
UFO Spotter

Pick a region to see what kind of sightings it has, and whether there are waves (many similar reports close in space and time) that look like something moving. Waves are candidates, not proof of "the same object": many have a mundane explanation (fireworks, fireballs, launches) and are labelled as such. Methods: DBSCAN (waves), PCA + Spearman (track), TF-IDF + LSA (text similarity), KMeans (sighting types).

data.text/html:
Sighting types

KMeans (k=5) on the report texts. Silhouette: 0.05 (near 0 = the types overlap a lot; short free-text reports usually score low, so read the words rather than trusting the boundaries).

Waves

Sorted by mover_score (alike reports that also advance along a line). Select a row to see its track and reports.

Caveats. Locations are city centroids. Reporting follows population and media attention, so busy places dominate. mover_score is a heuristic, not a probability. Data: NUFORC (unofficial?) reports.
